context_files_read.purpose: Read controlling repository safety, evidence, phase-loop, artifact, and P14 boundary rules.
key_findings: Default development phases are capped at 100 nodes and must never default to 1000 Valkey nodes.
Machine-readable artifacts are the product; reports and charts are only views over versioned artifacts.
Real Valkey proof must come from wrapper scripts and include independently probed Valkey 9.1.x endpoint evidence.
Missing metrics must be encoded as MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON and must never be invented.
Resource ownership, deterministic cleanup, and no host-network mutation are non-negotiable.

context_files_read.purpose: Confirm automatic phase ceiling, CLI contract, scale gate requirements, and P14 opt-in guard.
key_findings: Automatic execution completes through P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100.
Scale phases must execute real 10/30/50/100-node gates.
P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN requires explicit VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN opt-in and is dry-run/resource-check only.
Report artifacts must read machine-readable inputs and must not become source of truth.

context_files_read.purpose: Read the L07 stage goal, required harness scope, and acceptance criteria.
key_findings: L07 must enhance quantitative metrics and audit coverage for real 30/50/100 cluster build scenarios.

Required coverage includes resource preflight, process/container startup timing, cluster meet/create timing, slot assignment, role convergence, membership convergence, SET/GET data-path probe, cleanup timing and residual scan, and 30/50/100 scale report consistency.
1000+ must remain dry-run/resource/planner only.
Resource insufficiency cannot pass; it must become BLOCKED.
Visualizations must show the scale ladder and timing breakdown.

context_files_read.purpose: Confirm subagent role and JSON response contract.
key_findings: requirements_analyst performs requirements and gap analysis only, without writing implementation code.
The response must be JSON at artifacts/loop_engineering/stages/<stage>/subagents/requirements_analyst.json.
The response must identify current-stage problem, existing capability, gaps, acceptance criteria, and forbidden behavior.

context_files_read.purpose: Ensure this artifact conforms to the required subagent schema.
key_findings: Top-level additional properties are not allowed.
verdict must be APPROVED, CHANGES_REQUESTED, or BLOCKED.
proposed_harness entries must use one of the allowed harness type values.

context_files_read.purpose: Use the stage-specific context and constraints already gathered for L07.
key_findings: L07 must strengthen 30/50/100 real-cluster scale build metrics and audit surface.
P14 must not be run or marked as real coverage.
Resource insufficiency must be recorded as a blocker rather than passed with static artifacts.
Historical P12/P13 artifacts may have partial timing fields and must distinguish measured metrics from explicit gaps.

context_files_read.purpose: Map L07 requirements to P12/P13/P14 phase boundaries and required artifacts.
key_findings: P12_SCALE_LADDER_10_30 is automatic, real_valkey_required true, max_nodes 30, and includes resource_preflight_30 plus scale_30_real_gate.
P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100 is automatic, real_valkey_required true, max_nodes 100, and includes resource_preflight_50, scale_50_real_gate, resource_preflight_100, and scale_100_real_gate.
P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN is automatic false, real_valkey_required false, max_nodes 1000, and its gates require opt-in plus --dry-run planner/resource commands.

context_files_read.purpose: Identify validation expectations without running real scale gates or P14.
key_findings: The documented 30/50/100 validation flow runs resource preflight before each real scale gate.
If resource preflight fails, the real stage must not be marked PASS.
1000+ validation commands are explicitly dry-run only and must not be counted as real Valkey coverage.

context_files_read.purpose: Review current P13/P14 audit behavior relevant to L07 scale build requirements.
key_findings: The current audit verifies P13 50/100 evidence status, real_valkey true, node counts, cluster_state_observed ok, probe_result PASS, data_path_result PASS, Valkey 9.1.x versions, cleanup PASS, timing paths, timing categories, and cleanup residuals.
The current audit enforces P14 as dry-run only and blocks real P14 evidence or a default P14 gate result.
The current audit is P13/P14-focused and does not provide equivalent 30/50/100 build-metric parity as an L07 artifact.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect current metric catalog and coverage layering behavior.
key_findings: Coverage layers distinguish fake, small-real, 30, 50, 100, and 1000-dry-run.
1000 dry-run metrics are prevented from counting as real_valkey_coverage.
Current scale metrics include real evidence, node counts, primary/replica counts, cluster_known_nodes_max, memory, command counts, and selected P13 timing entries.
Current scale timing extraction only reads P13 p13_timing_breakdown_scale_*.json, so 30-node build timing parity is not yet evident.

context_files_read.purpose: Review provenance requirements for artifact-first evidence.
key_findings: Provenance tracks source artifacts, hashes, schemas, phase IDs, run IDs, and report views.
Report views must not become source-of-truth nodes.
P14 planner artifacts are classified as dry_run_plan and dry_run_only.

context_files_read.purpose: Review current resource preflight semantics.
key_findings: Resource preflight emits resource_preflight artifacts with status PASS or FAIL and can_run boolean.
Checks include config semantics, node_count_limit, Docker availability, CPU count, memory budget, disk free, client ports, cluster bus ports, and previous cleanup state.
The code can identify insufficient resources, but L07 needs a requirement that such insufficiency maps to BLOCKED rather than PASS.

context_files_read.purpose: Review available setup timeline fields for build metrics.
key_findings: The setup timeline model records required setup segments including process config, process start, cluster formation, cluster convergence wait, final snapshots, artifact writes, and state writes.
The schema and required segment list are currently named around P13 setup timelines and only allow scale_50 and scale_100 scenarios.
L07 requirements need 30-node parity or explicit missing semantics for comparable build timing fields.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect existing runtime evidence and timing surfaces for scale scenarios.
key_findings: Runtime supports P12 scale_30 and P13 scale_50/scale_100 scenarios.

P13 timing names include nodehost_start, process_config_prepare, process_start, process_ready_wait, primary_cluster_create, replica_meet, replica_replicate, runtime probes, wrapper data path probe, and cleanup.

Cleanup reports include process termination, process exit verification, nodehost empty verification, resource cleanup, residual scan, and bounded parallelism timing for process runtime scale scenarios.

context_files_read.purpose: Assess existing 30-node scale evidence and report fields.
key_findings: 30-node evidence is PASS, real_valkey true, nodes_observed 30, cluster_state_observed ok, probe_result PASS, data_path_result PASS, and Valkey 9.1.0.
The 30-node scale rung has primary_count 15, replica_count 15, slots_assigned 16384, cluster_known_nodes_min/max 30, and memory/command metrics.
The 30-node scale report has timing_breakdown_path null and setup_timeline_path null, so detailed build timing is absent unless L07 adds it or encodes explicit missing semantics.

context_files_read.purpose: Assess existing 50/100 real evidence and timing artifacts.
key_findings: 50/100 evidence is PASS, real_valkey true, expected node counts, cluster_state_observed ok, probe_result PASS, data_path_result PASS, and Valkey 9.1.0.

50/100 timing artifacts include setup_command_wall_seconds, cluster_create_duration_seconds, replica_config_duration_seconds, wrapper probe timings, data-path probe timing, cleanup_command_wall_seconds, artifact_write_seconds, and accounting fields.
Diagnostic full probe duration is encoded as MISSING, which is acceptable only with explicit missing semantics.
50/100 scale_ladder_report currently has timing_breakdown_path null and setup_timeline_path null even though timing artifacts exist separately, creating a report-consistency gap for L07.

context_files_read.purpose: Assess existing resource preflight evidence for 50/100.
key_findings: Both resource preflight artifacts are PASS and can_run true.
Both record Docker availability, CPU count, memory budget, disk, port availability, and previous cleanup state.
L07 still needs explicit acceptance criteria for the failure path: can_run false or failed checks must make the stage BLOCKED, not PASS.

context_files_read.purpose: Assess existing detailed setup timeline artifacts.
key_findings: 50/100 setup timelines are PASS and include setup wall time, total timeline time, unexplained seconds, largest segments, and largest gaps.
The largest segments expose cluster formation and process startup costs, including primary_cluster_create, replica_meet, replica_replicate, process_ready_wait, and nodehost_start_all.
The current setup timeline schema applies to 50/100 only, so 30-node L07 parity needs either a generalized metric artifact or explicit missing/skipped status.

context_files_read.purpose: Assess cleanup timing and residual scan evidence.
key_findings: 30/50/100 cleanup reports have status PASS and resources_remaining count zero.

50/100 cleanup reports include cleanup_timing fields for process termination, process exit verification, nodehost empty verification, container/network cleanup, residual scan, and bounded parallelism.
30-node cleanup report lacks comparable cleanup_timing, so L07 must either add it or encode the gap explicitly.

proposed_harness.name: l07_30_50_100_artifact_first_audit
proposed_harness.acceptance: The audit reads source JSON/JSONL artifacts, not HTML/SVG/CSV views, and verifies resource preflight, real evidence, timing, scale rung, cleanup, and provenance consistency for 30, 50, and 100.

proposed_harness.name: l07_resource_insufficiency_blocks

proposed_harness.name: l07_real_scale_evidence_requirements
proposed_harness.acceptance: For each of 30, 50, and 100, canonical wrapper evidence must be PASS, real_valkey true, nodes_observed equal to requested node count, cluster_state_observed ok, probe_result PASS, data_path_result PASS, Valkey version prefix 9.1., and probes length equal to node count.

proposed_harness.name: l07_build_timing_coverage
proposed_harness.acceptance: Each 30/50/100 record accounts for process/container startup timing, cluster meet/create timing, slot assignment timing, role convergence timing, membership convergence, SET/GET data-path probe timing/result, cleanup timing, and residual scan; missing fields carry MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON plus reason.

proposed_harness.name: l07_scale_report_visualization_consistency

proposed_harness.name: l07_p14_dryrun_boundary_guard
proposed_harness.acceptance: Any P14 real Valkey evidence, default P14 gate result, or 1000+ real_valkey_coverage entry is blocking; only dry-run/resource/planner artifacts with opt-in constraints may be referenced.

acceptance_criteria: L07 defines a canonical, artifact-first scale build metric contract covering exactly real node counts 30, 50, and 100, with 1000+ represented only as dry-run/resource/planner boundary data.

For node counts 30, 50, and 100, canonical evidence is traceable to wrapper-produced artifacts and includes source path, sha256, producer/schema metadata, phase_id, run_id, scenario, node_count, status, and provenance edges.

For each of 30, 50, and 100, resource_preflight must be PASS and can_run true before real evidence can be accepted; any failed check, can_run false, unavailable Docker, port collision, insufficient memory/disk, or prior cleanup residue makes the stage BLOCKED.

For each of 30, 50, and 100, real evidence must be PASS, real_valkey true, nodes_observed equal to the rung size, cluster_state_observed ok, probe_result PASS, data_path_result PASS, all observed Valkey versions starting with 9.1., and probe count equal to node count.

Build metrics must cover process/container startup timing, cluster meet/create timing, slot assignment timing, role convergence timing, membership convergence, SET/GET data-path probe timing/result, cleanup timing, and cleanup residual scan for each rung.

Where a required metric is not available, the artifact must encode MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON with a concrete reason and source context; numeric values must not be invented or copied from another rung.

30-node scale build metrics must either be measured to parity with 50/100 or explicitly identify each missing timing/cleanup field with missing semantics; a silent null timing path is not sufficient acceptance evidence.
50/100 scale reports or L07 aggregate artifacts must cross-link available timing and setup timeline artifacts so report consistency can be audited from machine-readable source files.
Scale ladder and timing breakdown visualizations must be generated from L07 machine-readable artifacts and must include 30, 50, and 100 rungs; HTML/SVG/CSV outputs remain views, not source evidence.
P13 optimization artifacts may be referenced as supplemental or comparative evidence only when labeled as such; canonical L07 acceptance must rely on P12 scale_30 and P13 scale_50/scale_100 evidence.
P14 remains automatic false and real_valkey_required false; no P14 real gate, no real 1000-node artifact, and no 1000+ real_valkey_coverage may appear in L07 acceptance.

Validation must include schema validation, artifact audit, metric coverage, provenance validation, report rendering checks, and blocker-path tests for resource insufficiency without running P14 or treating dry-run output as real.
risks: A stale committed PASS artifact could mask a current resource preflight failure unless L07 makes can_run false a blocker.
30-node scale evidence could be counted as complete because real Valkey proof exists even though detailed build timing parity is absent.
P13 optimization metrics could be mixed with canonical P13 rungs and obscure which evidence proves the 50-node acceptance criteria.
Report views could accidentally become the metric source of truth instead of scale_rung, timing, preflight, cleanup, and real evidence artifacts.
Diagnostic or setup metrics could be silently null rather than explicitly MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON.
1000 dry-run planner/resource artifacts could be misclassified as real scale coverage if layer and real_valkey_coverage guards are weakened.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not run P14 or any real 1000-node gate.
Do not count P14 or scale_1000 dry-run/resource/planner artifacts as real Valkey coverage.
Do not mark resource insufficiency, failed preflight, or can_run false as PASS.
Do not use HTML, SVG, CSV, markdown, or generated report views as source evidence for metrics.
Do not fabricate timing, convergence, SET/GET, cleanup, or residual values for missing 30-node fields.
Do not weaken schemas, manifest requirements, gate wrappers, provenance checks, or P14 opt-in guards.
Do not mutate host networking, firewall, routing, host interfaces, or unrelated processes.
Do not replace canonical P12/P13 scale evidence with P13O optimization artifacts without explicit supplemental classification.
commands_to_run: python3 -m pytest -q tests/scale tests/metrics tests/coverage tests/provenance tests/report tests/visualization
Do not run real 30/50/100 scale gates during requirements analysis; if implementation validation later needs them, run documented preflight first and BLOCK on failed resources.
Do not run P14 unless the user explicitly opts in in the current session and VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN is set to the required value; even then only dry-run/resource/planner commands are allowed.
notes: The L07 requirements and acceptance criteria are clear: produce artifact-first, schema-valid 30/50/100 scale build metrics; preserve real Valkey evidence boundaries; treat resource insufficiency as BLOCKED; keep P14 as dry-run/resource/planner only; and require visualization/report outputs to derive from machine-readable artifacts. Current gaps are primarily parity and cross-link gaps, especially 30-node build timing and cleanup timing versus 50/100.
